description: This file defines the enumeration LoopbackHost with static methods to identify if a host is a loopback or within local network ranges. It includes functions for parsing and validating IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: isLoopback
methods.description: Checks if the provided hostname is a loopback address (IPv4 or IPv6).

methods.name: isLoopbackHost
methods.description: Determines if a hostname string corresponds to a loopback host, considering various forms including standard localhost and IP addresses.

methods.name: isLocalNetworkHost
methods.description: Checks if a hostname belongs to the local network ranges or special local domain suffixes.

methods.name: parseIPv4
methods.description: Parses a string hostname into an IPv4 address tuple if valid.

methods.name: isLocalNetworkIPv4
methods.description: Checks whether an IPv4 address (as a tuple) falls within common private or local network ranges.
